jurisdiction.name: Sudan
jurisdiction.overview: Nationally published records appear separately from applicable EU-level records. The landscape, historical relationships and legal applicability remain under document-level review.

narrative.summary: Sudan has no AI law, AI strategy or data protection law. The only official AI commitment found is in the Central Bank of Sudan's Five-Year Strategic Plan 2026-2030, which plans the bank's own use of AI for monetary forecasting, operational data analysis and anti-money-laundering detection. The Prime Minister's March 2026 directives on AI in education are known only from press reports.
lead_institutions: Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Transformation
narrative.review_notes: This review was carried out on 12 October 2026. The telecoms regulator's website and the education, higher education and health ministries' websites could not be accessed, and the digital ministry's strategy and policy pages link only to placeholder files, so only one document could be read. Sudan is marked for a later retry and, as a country of over 20 million people with few records, for a longer catch-up pass.

instruments.official_title: الخطة الاستراتيجية الخمسية 2026-2030 (خطة التعافي والتحول الاستراتيجي)
instruments.english_title: Central Bank of Sudan Five-Year Strategic Plan 2026-2030 (Recovery and Strategic Transformation Plan)
instruments.current_status: Published on the Central Bank of Sudan website (PDF linked from the bank's strategic-plan page, read 2026-10-11). The date recorded is that of the Governor's foreword (31 December 2025); the document gives no separate approval or publication date. It is a general institutional plan, not an AI-specific instrument; it is recorded because it is the only official Sudanese document found that sets out AI commitments.
instruments.summary: The Central Bank of Sudan's five-year 'recovery and strategic transformation' plan for 2026-2030, prepared in the context of the war, with six strategic goals, thirty general objectives and 150 initiatives covering monetary stability, governance, financial inclusion, digital transformation and reform of financial institutions. Its AI-related initiatives commit the bank to use a central-bank version of AI tools to forecast monetary and financial trends, to introduce AI (the bank's own version) for analysing operational data, and to integrate AI and big-data analytics into the detection of money laundering. It contains no rules for AI use by banks or other supervised institutions.
instruments.ai_governance_relevance: Only official Sudanese document found with explicit AI commitments; sets the central bank's own planned use of AI in forecasting, operations and AML supervision.

leads.english_title: Prime Minister's executive directives on AI education, health-sector digitalisation and national project management (March 2026)
leads.issuing_authority: Prime Minister of Sudan (Council of Ministers)
leads.note: Reported (late March 2026) on the Embassy of Sudan in Berlin news blog and in press: Prime Minister Kamil Idris directed coordination with the Ministry of Higher Education to set up infrastructure for an AI bachelor's programme, a review of school curricula to incorporate AI, and digital education platforms, following a meeting with the Minister of Digital Transformation and Telecommunications. No official text of the directives was found on a Council of Ministers, ministry or gazette site on 2026-10-11; promote only if the directive text is published officially.
